diameter_status: Analyst-configured sensitivity cases; not measured diameters or a measured distribution
air_property_approximation: Dry-air properties; actual humidity unavailable, no evaporation model
atmosphere_status: 101325 Pa explicitly assumed; 20 C recorded; humidity unavailable
water_temperature_status: Assumed equal to recorded air temperature
gas_velocity_status: Assumed quiescent-air reference, not measured gas velocity
znmf_status: Hypothetical jet-interaction comparison using separate ZNMF local velocity, never measured PZT gas velocity; no spatial registration
height_reference: h=y-y0, y0 is first finite paired sample with N>=minimum_initial_sample_count; not atomiser surface
initial_condition: Lowest finite paired mean-u/v location on the existing fixed-x column with N>=minimum_initial_sample_count; reliability criterion is sample availability only
